name: Cobble Bag
summary: A shoe shop whose cart is a paper bag: shoes drop in, and it unfolds into a receipt
about: A small online shoe shop whose cart is a drawn paper shopping bag: every pair you add flies in an arc, drops through the opening and peeks out of the top, and the price tag counts your pairs. Tap the bag and it unfolds into a torn-edge receipt with quantities, a stamped promo code and PKR totals. Good for a shoe, sneaker or small fashion boutique that wants a playful, memorable cart.
how: Browse the walking-sneaker home page, pick a category or use Quick add on a card and choose a size.
In the shop, filter by type, colour, size in stock, price and new drops, then sort; the grid reshuffles smoothly.
On a product page, drag the shoe (or use the arrows) to turn it, pick a colour to repaint it and a size, then Drop in bag to watch it fly into the paper bag.
Tap the bag to unfold the receipt: change quantities, crumple a line away, or apply the code STEP15 to see it stamped on.
Check out with a validated delivery form; the bag is folded, sealed with your order number and ridden off by a courier.
Continue shopping brings back a fresh empty bag. With reduced motion every step still works without the flights.
